prospective_native_gate.scope: future identical-input native comparison; this baseline does not decide adoption

rss_semantics: whole process high-water mark including imports; bytes on macOS, KiB on Linux; not a per-workload incremental measurement
cache_semantics: first call and repeated warm calls in one process; first calls may share kernels warmed by earlier workloads; no claim of isolated cold cache

contract.search: bounded fixed candidate replay; no convergence benchmark

contract.source: eight synthetic coordinate replicas of LOVEexample; no independent sites

contract.validation: compute only; inputs already frozen and validated; not equivalent facade latency

limits: No parallel scaling or isolated startup/RSS comparison
Replay candidates do not establish optimizer convergence
Compute-only dot alternative excludes facade validation and output ownership
